targets.query: from(bucket: v.bucket) |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "microgrid" and (r._field == "active_power_w" or r._field == "dc_power_w")) |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)

from(bucket: v.bucket) |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "microgrid" and (r._field == "ac_voltage_v" or r._field == "dc_voltage_v")) |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)

from(bucket: v.bucket) |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "microgrid" and r._field == "frequency_hz") |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)

from(bucket: v.bucket) |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "microgrid" and (r._field == "cabinet_temperature_c" or r._field == "heatsink_temperature_c")) |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)

from(bucket: v.bucket) |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "microgrid" and (r._field == "operating_state" or r._field == "event_bits" or r._field == "poll_errors")) |> last()
